scienceNote: This qualitative illustration enlarges hydrated ions, water and solutes. Electrostatic forces are screened and exaggerated for visibility; this is not a molecular dynamics simulation. MF and UF illustrate size separation; NF selectivity depends on solute and membrane properties. RO uses a dense selective layer under pressure, not visible honeycomb pores. Rejected glyphs recycle upstream; flow rates, concentration balance and residual salt are not quantified. The final vessel represents water-rich permeate, not a purity guarantee.
